mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% annualized indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL rises above 2% without subsequent tightening.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points within a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE rises without subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of periods with declining RSAFS, or RSAFS declines without subsequent demand weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO drops without subsequent supply chain issues.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of high FEDFUNDS and rising CPIAUCSL does not lead to tightening.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month, coupled with an increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points, signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS drops > 100k and UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of PAYEMS drop and UNRATE rise does not lead to labor market weakness.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in a month signals strengthening demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST rises without subsequent demand strength.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a rise in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO rises without subsequent economic strength during late-cycle expansion.
